scope: No person-level owner/parcel rows are preloaded. Lawfully obtained State source documents or authorised API responses may be imported by authority/admin with provenance; imported rows remain unverified until the exact source document is uploaded and reviewed. The independent third-party aggregator connector is on-demand only and does not persist responses. A source-record holder match is not legal title adjudication.

policy.ownerNamesAccess: Authority/admin only; all other roles receive masked metadata.
policy.verificationRequires: Actual reviewed source document uploaded so the server computes SHA-256, HTTPS government/NIC source URL, source record reference, and authority identity.
